newsitem.title: UK: Sears to pledge investor payout - report.
newsitem.headline: Sears to pledge investor payout - report.

text.p: British retailer Sears Plc is set to pledge a special dividend or share buyback worth as much as 500 million pounds ($840.3 million), the Daily Telegraph reported on Monday.
"The bulk of the cash will be raised from the long-awaited disposal of the Freemans mail-order business to Littlewoods for about 400 million pounds ($672.2 million)," the newspaper said.
"The two sides are thought to have agreed the details of the deal and are expected to announce them today or tomorrow."
In December 1996, Sears confirmed it was in advanced talks with the privately owned Littlewoods Organisation on the sale of its Freemans business.
